title: Raw evaluation with coefficient pulled back from a fixed base
statement: Let B,T,Y be schemes, h:Y→B and g:Y→T, K a bounded-below derived abelian etale sheaf on T, q an integer and U etale over B. Define the homomorphism from Hom(Z[h*U][0],g*K[q]) to H^q(U×_B Y,(snd≫g)*K) as raw derived evaluation followed by cohomology of the inverse derived inverse-image composition comparison. Here Z[h*U] means h* of the free abelian represented sheaf of U; all inverse images are those of [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], and cohomology is [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].

def rawFixedDerivedComparison {B T Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (h : Y ⟶ B) (g : Y ⟶ T)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (q : ℤ) (U : B.Etale) :
    AddCommGrpCat.of ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      (((h)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj ((abelianComparisonFree B).obj U)) ⟶
      ((D+((g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).obj K)⟦q⟧) ⟶
    (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback U.hom h) q).obj
      (((pullback.snd U.hom h ≫ g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        K.obj)
